thread:
Joanna Park: Heads up — recruiter accidentally double-booked two onsite loops for candidate Priyam this afternoon. He's already in town and at reception now. We need to consolidate into a single, slightly longer loop and secure an isolated VM for a short take-home coding task. Can people-ops triage?
Derek Huang: I can absorb panels. Which interviews are colliding?
Joanna Park: PM loop (45m) at 14:00 and Eng loop (60m) at 15:00. Candidate arrived early and would prefer to do both back-to-back if panelists agree. Also requested private network for the coding task (no internet).
Maya Singh: I can shift other commitments and take the PM loop 14:00. I'll shorten Eng loop to 50m and make room. Need to notify panels.
Ibrahim Khan: Security: Isolated VM possible for guest candidate with no internet?
Security Bot: Yes — we can provision an ephemeral VM on the internal lab VLAN with NAT disabled. Requires signed NDA, and candidate must use our hardware loaner. ETA 25m to provision.
Front Desk Bot: Candidate at reception, asked for a quiet room and a laptop if needed. Photo ID present.
Derek Huang: I'll ping Eng panel now to confirm they can compress their questions. If any cannot move, we'll remote one of the panels.
Joanna Park: Also note candidate requested to record whiteboard notes — we must forbid recording per policy. Please remind panelists.
Maya Singh: Noted. I'll message panelists: shorten to 50m Eng, 40m PM, 10m buffer. If Alex can't move, we shift his slot to remote later tonight.
Ibrahim Khan: Security: we need candidate name + ID scan to create temporary VM user. Also sign paper NDA (we'll keep a scanning copy).
Joanna Park: Sending ID scan now. Also need a MacBook loaner with HDMI and a discrete ethernet adapter for the VM host — Derek can fetch? @Derek
Derek Huang: I can grab a MacBook from Locker 1. Will leave it at Quiet Room H by 13:55 with labeled pouch. Sticky will include WiFi creds in case fallback needed.
Infra Bot: Provisioning ephemeral VM (no internet) on lab VLAN. VM image: ubuntu-22.04-build. SSH key will be delivered to receptionist for pickup. ETA ~18 minutes.
Front Desk Bot: NDA printed and ready. Candidate to sign at check-in; badge queued (code 6612) for pickup.
Joanna Park: Also coordinate with interview host — please remove camera recording permission and disable external sharing for the room. Security, can you confirm?
Security Bot: Confirmed: room recording disabled and external sharing blocked. We'll escort candidate to Quiet Room H at check-in.
Derek Huang: MacBook loaner placed at Quiet Room H at 13:50 with HDMI + ethernet adapter. Sticky: `WiFi: Redwood-Guest | PW: visit2026`.
Maya Singh: I messaged both panels and consolidated invites: 14:00 consolidated loop (PM + Eng), 90m total with 10m break in middle. Remote fallback link included. Panelists accepted except Alex, who can only do remote at 18:00.
Joanna Park: Plan B if Alex remote: run loop without Alex and schedule a 1:1 remote with him at 18:00. Candidate OK with that?
Front Desk Bot: Candidate signed NDA and picked up badge at 13:52.
Infra Bot: Ephemeral VM ready. SSH key printed and in sealed envelope at reception. VM user: pri-yam-temp. No internet egress.
Ibrahim Khan: VM validated. Please instruct candidate: do not attempt network access; disconnected by default. I'll be on-call if they need package installs (we can pre-stage).
Derek Huang: Left a short note on the Mac: how to connect to VM via ethernet: `open terminal -> ssh pri-yam-temp@10.20.3.45 -i /Users/guest/.ssh/id_ed25519`
Joanna Park: Candidate confirmed consolidated schedule and is in Quiet Room H. Thanks team. Closing thread — will run the 18:00 remote 1:1 if Alex needs it.
